title: App Feels Earthquakes Through Mobile Phones

image.attribution: Maurizio Pesce from Milan, Italia / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-2.0

main_content:
A new phone app uses vibrations from smartphones to alert people about earthquakes.

The phone app recognizes sudden shaking of the earth’s surface through sensors in smartphones.

The new app is called MyShake. It is the work of four researchers at the University of California, Berkeley. They said they created a worldwide warning system.

The MyShake app is available only for Android phones.
